summary: SOLVED the (1=1) box-spline cross-term of N_6 and assembled the FULL closed form for A_6 in the three-minus sector, verified exactly. The (1=1) cross-term is a matching-PAIR product (k_ij)_+(k_kl)_+ with exponent 1 on each factor (NOT a triple): I measured it directly (the single-wall jump coefficient P_ij kinks across a matching-partner wall, jump = k_kl * R with k_kl to first power) and confirmed globally by an exact modular fit (M = base + single(1=1) + pair(1=1) = rank 100, CONSISTENT; triple adds +0). Assembled N_6 = B + sum (b_j-a_i)_+ P_ij + sum (b_j-a_i)_+(b_l-a_k)_+ R + sum (a_i-b_j-b_k)_+^3 Q with all coefficients exact, and verified A_6 = i 2^5 g^-3 N_6/(e3m+e3p) against my own ./bg AND the independent pybg at 16/16 generic points across 8 chamber types plus two-sided limits onto a (1=1), a (1=2), and a matching-corner wall (all exact). n=7 probe (exact): (1=1) exponent still 1, subset-sum wall exponent n-3=4, and disjoint (1=1) edges force a (1=2) (so the n=6 bijective-matching structure is special to equal triples).
